tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run JavaScript to compose existing tools and filter large results before they enter context. Use await tools.call("Read", {file_path:"..."}); results have text/result fields. tools.list() lists names/descriptions; use existing tool schemas or ToolSearch for unfamiliar schemas. Return a small JSON value or emit(value). Every underlying call keeps its normal permissions. Use Promise.all for independent Read/Grep/Glob calls (up to 4 at once); await dependencies. All other tools are sequential barriers. Await all calls, and await reads before dependent mutations. No Node, imports, filesystem, network, timers, or persistent state in the guest. Limits: 32 calls, 60s, 32MiB guest memory, 16000 output characters. Effects are real and not rolled back on error. Use direct tools for simple calls or images/interactive capabilities.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
